Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with a three-day history of severe, watery diarrhea.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I think it's diarrhoea. And it's like just coming out, like loads of it. Like I go to the toilet and it's just super watery... it's been about three days now.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is opening their bowels almost every hour while awake.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I feel like it's like almost every hour, when I'm awake.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The diarrhea is associated with intermittent, central, cramping abdominal pain (severity 6-7/10).
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I feel, I feel a cramp. and then, and then I know it's time to go right?... it feels pretty , like in the middle... it it comes and goes... maybe is that like a six, or a seven?

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels nauseous and has vomited, particularly after drinking milk.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I definitely feel kind of nauseous... I've have vomited... whenever I have like milk or something like that, I just feel like I want to vomit.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient feels very hot and feverish but has not measured a temperature.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I feel kind of really hot all the time. And uh I'm pretty sure I'm burning up.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies seeing any blood in the stool.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Have you got any blood in your stools? no I don't, I don't remember anything, like, no I , I think it's just I, nothing like that.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is passing urine less frequently than usual.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um yeah a bit, I guess less frequently maybe.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient's brother has had similar symptoms for five days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: my um my brother has had, actually had something like this for um he has it as well for five days, as well.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient is otherwise fit and well with no significant past medical history.
Past_Medical_History.source_text: I think otherwise I'm fit and well.

Medications.content: Patient is not on any regular medications but has been taking Paracetamol recently.
Medications.source_text: I'm not on any regular medication or anything like that.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.source_text: I don't have any allergies that I know of.

Family_History.source_text: my, my dad actually has um colon cancer at the moment.

Social_and_Family_History.source_text: my name is uh Dan Choudhry. I am seven, twenty seven.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives with his sister and mother.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I live with my, um sister and my mum.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient works in a government office in Central London.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I work at a, I I work at um an office, um in Central London... I work in government.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient smokes socially (e.g., on a Friday).
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I smoke um, I smoke uh, uh for like socially, but not like regularly.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient drinks alcohol, including beer during the week and more heavily on occasion.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I might have a a beer during the weekdays... On Fridays I have more um alcohol

Assessment.source_text: I think your symptoms are suggestive of something called gastroenteritis.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to prioritize fluid intake to stay hydrated.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Drink, make sure you drink plenty of fluids, OK?

Plan_of_Care.content: Recommended an over-the-counter oral rehydration solution like Dioralyte.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: you can get things like Diarolyte, which is um, a fluid replacement you can get from the pharmacy.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised to eat a soft diet (soup, mash) and gradually build up as tolerated.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: You can use soft diet, things like soup, mash. And then gradually build up

Plan_of_Care.content: Recommended regular Paracetamol if feeling feverish or for pain.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: If you are having, if you've got a bit of tummy pain, if you're feeling feverish, then I think Paracetamol is very sensible.
Try and avoid alcohol if you can.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to call back in 48 hours if symptoms are not settling down, as further investigations may be needed for dehydration.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: But if your symptoms aren't settling down in the next couple of days, so forty eight hours, I want you to give me a call back... if you are getting dehydrated then we need to do further investigations, OK?
